fusions.name: Spotter's Spike
fusions.desc: From high in your crown you loose a thrown spike that deals 26 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, reaching 50% further (up to 1.2 times the damage at full reach), and leaves the target [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Brought to Ground
fusions.desc: Strikes a target at or below 30% of its health, dealing 20 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds as roots catch it.

fusions.name: Trunk to Trunk
fusions.desc: Steps you through the trees to a point up to 8 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds after.

fusions.name: Scent Through the Soil
fusions.desc: Against a target at low health, your damage rises by 12%.
